title: One sentence from an untrained staffer launched 60 AI agents at the Riemann hypothesis
description:
An untrained staffer prompted Anthropic's unreleased model to "take a real stab" at the Riemann hypothesis, and the AI self-organized a full research program. Sixty parallel agents tested roughly 650 approaches over 36 hours, with half going down dead ends before two developed the key ideas and human mathematicians verified the result in Lean. The increment on a 167-year-old, million-dollar problem is deliberately modest. The structural shift is enormous: research is becoming something one person can convene, delegate, and check, with the hardest coordination handled by the AI itself.
